question: How do I reset my password?
answer: Go to the login page and click 'Forgot Password'. Enter your registered email address and you'll receive a password reset link within a few minutes. The link is valid for 30 minutes.

question: How can I create a new account?
answer: Click the 'Sign Up' button on the homepage, fill in your name, email, and a secure password, then verify your email address using the confirmation link we send you.

question: How do I update my email address?
answer: Log in, go to Account Settings > Profile, and edit your email address. You'll need to confirm the change via a verification email sent to the new address.

question: How do I delete my account?
answer: Go to Account Settings > Privacy > Delete Account. Note that this action is permanent and all your data will be removed within 30 days as per our data retention policy.

question: Why is my internet connection so slow?
answer: Slow connections are usually caused by network congestion, too many connected devices, or router issues. Try restarting your router, moving closer to it, or running a speed test to check if your ISP is delivering the promised bandwidth.

question: How do I fix a Wi-Fi connection that keeps dropping?
answer: Update your router's firmware, change the Wi-Fi channel to avoid interference, and ensure your device's network drivers are up to date. If the issue persists, try resetting the router to factory settings.

question: My application keeps crashing, what should I do?
answer: First, make sure the app is updated to the latest version. Clear the app cache, restart your device, and if the problem continues, uninstall and reinstall the application.

question: How do I clear my browser cache?
answer: In most browsers, go to Settings > Privacy and Security > Clear Browsing Data, select 'Cached images and files', and click Clear Data. This can resolve many loading and display issues.

question: What payment methods do you accept?
answer: We accept all major credit and debit cards (Visa, Mastercard, American Express), PayPal, and UPI payments. Some regions also support Apple Pay and Google Pay.

question: How do I get a refund?
answer: Refund requests can be submitted within 14 days of purchase from the Billing section of your account. Approved refunds are processed within 5-7 business days to your original payment method.

question: Why was I charged twice for the same order?
answer: Duplicate charges are usually a temporary authorization hold from your bank rather than an actual double charge, and they typically disappear within 3-5 business days. If it persists, contact our billing support with your order ID.

question: How do I cancel my subscription?
answer: Go to Account Settings > Subscription > Cancel Plan. You will retain access until the end of your current billing cycle, and you won't be charged again after cancelling.

question: Do you offer a free trial?
answer: Yes, we offer a 14-day free trial with full access to all premium features. No credit card is required to start the trial.

question: How do I contact customer support?
answer: You can reach our support team via live chat (available 24/7), email at support@example.com, or by calling our helpline during business hours (9 AM - 6 PM, Mon-Fri).

question: What are your customer support hours?
answer: Live chat support is available 24/7. Phone support is available Monday to Friday, 9 AM to 6 PM. Email queries are typically answered within 24 hours.

question: Is my personal data safe with you?
answer: Yes, we use industry-standard encryption (TLS/SSL) for all data in transit and at rest. We never sell your personal data to third parties, and you can review our full privacy policy on our website.

question: How do I enable two-factor authentication?
answer: Go to Account Settings > Security > Two-Factor Authentication, and follow the steps to link an authenticator app or your phone number for SMS codes.

question: What should I do if I suspect unauthorized access to my account?
answer: Immediately change your password, enable two-factor authentication, and review your recent account activity log. Contact our support team right away so we can help secure your account.

question: Which devices and browsers are supported?
answer: Our platform works on the latest versions of Chrome, Firefox, Safari, and Edge, on both desktop and mobile. We recommend keeping your browser updated for the best experience.

question: How do I download my data?
answer: Go to Account Settings > Privacy > Export My Data. You'll receive a downloadable archive of your account data via email within 24 hours.
